title: kailarsenia godefroyana
intro: Kailarsenia godefroyana, commonly known as the Kailarsenia godefroyana plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties.
